eyebrow: A type that holds whatever you give it
caption: Nothing in T-SQL is structurally similar to a native VARIANT column.

code:
SELECT
  payload:action AS action,
  payload:user.name AS user_name,
  payload['user']['name'] AS user_name_alt
FROM events;
caption: Colon starts the path; dots or brackets chain into nested fields.

code:
SELECT
  payload:user.name::STRING AS user_name,
  payload:user.age::NUMBER AS user_age
FROM events;
caption: A VARIANT path is still a VARIANT until you cast it to a real type.

code:
-- T-SQL -- JSON stored as plain text, read with functions
SELECT JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.user.name') AS user_name
FROM events; -- payload is an NVARCHAR column
caption: T-SQL leans on functions over text; Snowflake gives JSON a native type.
